name: Pulse Buds 141

specs.battery_life: 42 hours total playback (6 hours per bud)
specs.charging: USB Type-C ASAP charge (10 min gives 75 min)

documentation:
Pulse Buds 141 - Battery life: Provides up to 42 hours of total playback time with the charging case. Each earbud provides 6 hours on a single charge.

Pulse Buds 141 - Pairing Guide: Open the charging case near your smartphone and select 'Pulse Buds 141' from available Bluetooth devices. Ensure earbuds are charged above 20%.

Pulse Buds 141 - Warranty & Service: Comes with a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Physical and liquid damage are not covered under warranty.

name: Pulse Buds 131

specs.battery_life: 60 hours total playback (8 hours per bud)
specs.charging: USB Type-C fast charge (5 min gives 60 min)

documentation:
Pulse Buds 131 - Battery life: Delivers up to 60 hours of total playtime with the case. Individual buds last up to 8 hours.

Pulse Buds 131 - Audio Drivers: Powered by 13mm dynamic sound drivers for enhanced vocal clarity and deep bass response.

name: Nova Watch Pro

specs.battery_life: Up to 7 days normal use, 14 days standby
specs.health_sensors: Continuous Heart Rate, SpO2, Sleep stages, Stress level

documentation:
Nova Watch Pro - Battery and Charging: The 300mAh high-density battery delivers up to 7 days of normal usage and charges fully in 90 minutes via magnetic fast puck.

Nova Watch Pro - Health Sensors: Features advanced optical sensors for 24/7 continuous heart rate monitoring, real-time blood oxygen (SpO2) alerts, and automatic sleep tracking.
